I built mine quite a few years ago:
 https://goo.gl/photos/CrX2pSaAmgnLNM398 
(The monitor arrangement is much better now :) Precor 956i with the entire upper structure removed - control panel is not visible but on the left. I bought it from a gym going out of business. Lift is a Conset 501-11 1B116. I don't remember who I bought it from.  Google Conset 501-11 and you will find many Conset resellers. I made the table top. It's been going strong for 6+ years.  I no longer work at home so I don't use it but my wife does her writing - about 10-15 hours week - on the treadmill.
